_meta: Atomic lessons — one record per line, JSON object. Schema by-example from first mining pass (xalgorix, 2026-09-07). Fields: id (unique, prefix L-<pack-short>-<n>), class (canonical from CLASS_KEYWORDS in build-registry.py), title (≤80 chars, human), capability_effect (one sentence — what does knowing this lesson give an operator), attribution (<pack>#<extraction-key>, grep-friendly), evidence (path:line pointer to source proof), activation (array of match conditions — brain.sh recall surfaces this record when ALL match), confidence (0.0-1.0), source_pack (pack name for retrieval attribution), added_at (YYYY-MM-DD). Query via jq or `bash scripts/brain.sh recall <target>`. Retrieval telemetry (per user directive: measure impact, not fold count) — every recall that returns this record MUST log to brain/telemetry/retrievals.jsonl for downstream attribution.

title: SPF/DKIM/DMARC/relay is a mad-hacks coverage gap
capability_effect: Recognize that xalgorix's phase-15 (email security) has no mad-hacks equivalent — add SPF/DKIM/DMARC/open-relay probes when a target has MX records

title: WebSocket testing is a mad-hacks coverage gap
capability_effect: Recognize phase-17 (WebSocket) has no dedicated agent — fall back to references/hunt-xss.md postMessage sub-technique or manual wscat probing when target has ws:// or wss:// endpoints

title: Non-WordPress CMS coverage gap (Drupal/Joomla/Ghost)
capability_effect: Only WordPress has a dedicated recon path (references/wordpress-recon.md); Drupal/Joomla/Ghost need manual CMS-specific enumeration until an agent is added

title: Broken-link hijacking + content spoofing gap
capability_effect: Adjacent to subdomain-takeover but no dedicated agent — manually check dangling third-party CDN/S3 references in HTML for takeover-via-broken-link when doing surface probe

title: 'Detect vs prove' — proof-of-exploit doctrine
capability_effect: A finding is not real until re-exploited by a fresh, adversarial run. Xalgorix's tagline 'Most scanners detect. Xalgorix proves' matches the mad-hacks VERIFY + REFUTE gates — do NOT ship findings that only 'look like' a bug without independent re-exploitation

title: 22-phase completeness checklist as coverage metric
capability_effect: Use xalgorix's 22 phases (references/xalgorix-methodology.md:8-33 table) as an engagement completeness self-check — for any engagement, tick each phase as done/skipped-with-reason. A 20/22 coverage claim needs 2 explicit skipped-with-reason entries, not silent omission

title: AILA architecture archetype — modular AI security platform
capability_effect: Recognize the AILA-shaped target: Python/FastAPI backend + Postgres+pgvector + ARQ/Redis + React 19 pnpm workspace + per-module frontends mounted from modules/<id>/frontend/. When a target matches, expect module-boundary attack surface: cross-module RBAC gaps, SSE event stream auth bypass, module-contributed routers with weaker auth than platform routers, module marketplace supply-chain, JWT scope-per-module vs global

title: exploitarium is a searchable PoC archive — grep before writing fresh
capability_effect: Before writing a fresh PoC for a well-known target software, grep packs/exploitarium/ for prior work. 39 self-contained PoC folders across: 7zip, anydesk, c-ares, curl, discord, discourse, docker, ffmpeg, firefox, floci, flowise, ghidra, gitea, gogs, imagemagick, ladybird, and more. Assigned CVEs indexed in packs/exploitarium/cves.md (CVE-2026-58049..58058, CVE-2026-58592..58593). Each folder preserves original README + tracked exploit files

title: skraft9/vuln-research is active — check monthly for new CVE PoCs

Upstream is active; re-mining every ~30 days catches new methodologies. title: secrets-patterns-db is the SPOT for secret-detection regex
capability_effect: 1610+ regex patterns for API keys/tokens/secrets, all ReDoS-safe, categorized by confidence. Feeds trufflehog + gitleaks via a single format. mad-hacks uses this via scripts/secrets-scan.sh wrapper with pre-generated rules in brain/registry/secrets-rules/ — do NOT hand-write secret regexes; extend this DB upstream instead

title: rifteo-skills is a peer methodology library — 38 skills, load-on-demand

Catalog at references/rifteo-skills-catalog.md maps every Rifteo skill to (a) our native equivalent (use ours), or (b) GAP (load Rifteo's). capability_effect: jo-inc/camofox-browser (MIT, 9.5k stars, active) at packs/camofox-browser/ is the actual runtime for browser-stealth-agent + browser-verifier — PR#1 deleted those agents because the phantom camofox_ctl.sh wrapper path didn't exist, but the underlying REST API + accessibility-tree contract at :9377 matches.
